observations: Three photos show a white upright freezer with a beige top and handle.
The brand 'Indesit' is visible on the front in all three photos, with a logo above the name.
The freezer has significant surface damage: scratches, dents, and peeling paint, especially on the front and right side.
The freezer appears to be in a domestic or storage setting with tiled flooring and wooden furniture in the background.
No power cord or plug is visible in any photo.
No model number or capacity label is visible on the exterior.

claims.evidence: The brand 'Indesit' is visible in all photos, but the 100L capacity is not visible on the unit. No model or capacity label is shown.
No interior shots, no power cord visible, no video or photo of the freezer running. Cannot verify functionality from photos alone.

risks.risk: Freezer may not be 100L as claimed
risks.proof: Photo of the model label or capacity sticker on the unit, or a side-by-side with a known 100L unit.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic upright freezer without capacity specification, which may be smaller or larger than 100L.

risks.proof: Video or photo showing the freezer powered on, interior lit, and frost or frozen contents.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, which significantly reduces value.

risks.risk: Hidden internal damage or poor insulation
risks.proof: Interior shot showing shelves, condition of walls, and frost buildup.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having potential internal damage, reducing value.

risks.proof: Photo of the power cord and plug, or a shot showing the freezer plugged in and powered.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially missing cord, which may require replacement or render it unusable.

proof_requests: Photo of the model and capacity label on the freezer.
Video or photo showing the freezer powered on and interior lit.
Interior shot showing shelves and condition inside.
Photo of the power cord and plug.
response.reason: The brand is confirmed, but the 100L capacity and working condition are unverified. Without proof of functionality and capacity, the item cannot be priced accurately. The visible damage also affects value, but the hidden risks (working status, internal condition, cord) must be resolved first.
